docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,743.00 FILED BY CAYCO, LOURDES AS TO DEFENDANT VILLAMEJOR, XENIA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-05-2022 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $40) SERVED JUN-30-2022, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT VILLAMEJOR, XENIA

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-05-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO SEP-07-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF LOURDES CAYCO IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT XENIA VILLAMEJOR IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1,383.00 (WHICH INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT MADE A PERSONAL CHECK OUT TO PLAINTIFF DATED AUGUST 5, 2022, FROM XENIA VILLAMEJOR TO LOURDES CAYCO. CHECK WAS REVIEWED BY THE JUDGE, PLAINTIFF APPROVED CHECK AND THE CHECK WAS DELIVERED IN COURT. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE SEP-07-2022 HEARING IF PAYMENT OF CHECK IS INSUFFICIENT. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF LOURDES CAYCO IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT XENIA VILLAMEJOR IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
